svg.title: AWS deployment architecture and trust boundaries
svg.desc: AWS target architecture showing regional services, account and VPC boundaries, Go Lambda stages, Aurora persistence, S3 artifact storage, security and observability controls, and direct Anthropic egress.
svg.text: Pinned source versions, durable orchestration, bounded assessment, validated findings
Regional services and the private application/data network
Subnet layout and outbound route are deployment choices.
IAM scopes each worker; Secrets Manager supplies credentials; KMS controls encryption; CloudTrail and CloudWatch serve distinct audit/ops needs.
Business audit, result provenance, reviewer decisions and spend ledger live in Aurora—not ordinary logs.
Open choices to resolve: ingress profile; VPC/AZ topology; trigger for dispatch reconciliation; outbound egress; key ownership; artifact retention.
